name: Wise
look: Sage-tinted canvas with a single lime CTA, a two-face display pairing, and a 24px radius on everything.

hero.title: The real exchange rate, and the fee up front
hero.sub: Send money abroad at the mid-market rate with the fee shown as a number before you commit. No spread hidden in the rate, ever.

features.title: No spread, just a fee
features.sub: Banks hide their margin inside the exchange rate. We charge a stated fee and use the real rate.

items.title: Mid-market rate
items.body: The rate you see on a search engine, not a marked-up version of it.

items.title: Fee stated first
items.body: One number, before you confirm, with the breakdown available if you want it.

items.title: Often instant
items.body: Around six in ten transfers arrive within seconds; the rest show an estimated time.

items.title: Local account details
items.body: Get account details in ten currencies and be paid like a local.

items.title: Spend anywhere
items.body: A card that converts at the same rate, with no foreign transaction fee.

items.title: For business too
items.body: Batch payments, multi-user access and accounting integrations.

showcases.title: Batch payments without the spreadsheet
showcases.body: Pay a thousand contractors in forty currencies from one file, with each recipient's fee shown before the batch runs and a reconciliation export afterwards.
points: Fees shown before the batch executes

showcases.title: Be paid like a local

points: Hold balances and convert when you choose
Direct debits supported in supported markets

testimonial.quote: I compared it against my bank on a two thousand pound transfer. The bank's 'no fee' cost eighty-one pounds in the rate. That was the last transfer I sent with them.
testimonial.name: Daniel Osei

pricing.title: PRICING
pricing.sub: A stated fee per transfer. No subscription.

tiers.name: Card
tiers.desc: Adds a card that spends at the same rate.

items.a: The midpoint between buy and sell prices on the global currency market — the rate a search engine shows. We use it and charge a separate stated fee.
Because many charge nothing visible and take their margin inside the exchange rate. Compare the amount that actually arrives, not the advertised fee.

items.q: How long does a transfer take?
items.a: About six in ten arrive within seconds. The rest depend on the corridor and the receiving bank, and an estimate is shown before you confirm.
Customer funds are safeguarded in segregated accounts at established banks, separate from company money, as required by the regulators we are licensed under.

cta.title: Send your first transfer
cta.sub: The real rate, the fee stated first, and no subscription.

footer.tagline: The real exchange rate, and the fee up front.

notes: A single lime green is the universal primary action colour. There is no second accent anywhere in the system.
The typographic story is a two-face contrast: a heavy proprietary display at hero scale against a neutral sans at sub-display.
24px is the canonical radius for both cards and buttons — generous and friendly, applied consistently.
The sage-tinted canvas is the hero surface; white is reserved for the cards sitting inside that band.
A full semantic palette exists for in-product use — positive, warning and negative families each with content, hover and active variants.
